summary: STERIS plc disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, STERIS Corporation, signed an October 11, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire all equity interests of Xodus Medical, Inc., a Pennsylvania specialty surgical products business, plus related affiliates, for $2.1 billion cash at closing, subject to customary adjustments, with up to $150 million additional earnout tied to calendar 2028 performance targets. Sellers are Craig E. Kaforey and Mark A. Kaforey and their legacy trusts. Financing is primarily debt, supported by a $2.0 billion senior unsecured bridge facility committed by JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs. Closing is anticipated by December 31, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals; outside date July 12, 2027, extendable to January 11, 2028. Watch antitrust/regulatory timing, bridge syndication, and earnout mechanics.
